_note: QA of the THIRD (structural) regeneration wave over the same 48 tiles that failed the first two attempts. Method: every one of the 48 new files at /home/crow/music/groove/public/covers/<skin>/<genre>.jpg was opened at full size (1024x1024) with read_image and judged on R1 genre, R2 skin palette/medium, R3 craft (no readable text/letters/numerals/brand/pseudo-word, not blank) and R4 no-cliche. Verdict basis is the specific defect that caused the earlier reject (regen2_verification.json still_fail_list.reasons), so a tile PASSes only if that defect is gone and no new R1-R4 defect is present. In addition 10 _rejected originals were opened at full size to distinguish 'defect gone' from 'merely changed': comic chicago-blues/electro/vaporwave; soviet death-metal, microhouse, hard-trance; sovietYears dream-trance, kawaii-future-bass, chicago-house; pixel amapiano. All 48 new files exist, are 1024x1024, and differ from their _rejected original (md5 differs for all 48; coarse 16x16 pixel difference 10.25-52.06), so nothing was re-shipped unchanged. Objective checks used alongside the visual read: (a) whole-image palette_distance from _batch_review.py is 0.003-0.249 for all 48, far under the 0.60 flag, so global palette is honoured and every R2 finding below is a LOCAL leak; (b) a two-ink test on the 17 sovietYears tiles measured the fraction of pixels more than 90 RGB units from any of black #111111 / red #cc0000 / paper #f4f1e1 - median 9.6% for the 12 R2-flagged tiles against a 8.0% floor for the 142 non-flagged sovietYears tiles (the floor is aged-paper grain and JPEG noise), so the appended 'hard two-ink regional constraint' produced no measurable tightening, and the residual off-ink pixels cluster on exactly the offending hue of each tile (purple #602060 = 8.6% of dream-trance, orange #e0c080+#e0c060 = 14.4% of afro-house, green #a0a060/#406020 in melodic-house, pink #e0a0a0 = 6.2% of vaporwave, fog greys #404040/#c0a0a0 = 24.5% off-ink in wave, cyan #204040 in electro). Key text comparison: the strings still readable in the 26 soviet tiles were compared with the wave-2 strings quoted in regen2_verification.json; 19 of 26 are character-for-character the same as the wave-2 string and the other 7 differ by at most one or two characters or by plate layout, and in three cases (hard-trance CADINRE, microhouse ROURS, synthwave YEB AER) the _rejected original shows the wave-1 string was different (THASRE, COINS) while wave 3 reproduced the wave-2 wording string exactly - i.e. the structural prompt change left the lettering untouched.

structural_change_verdict: No - the structural prompt change did not measurably beat the wording change. Outcome is identical: wave 3 passes 0 of 48, exactly as wave 2 passed 0 of 48 (delta 0 tiles, 0 percentage points), and every one of the 48 remains in the same defect family it failed on before. (1) Lettering: removing the trigger words (harp, stencil, stencilled, nameplate, signage, letter plates, typographic) and appending the blank-surfaces clause left readable letterforms in 26 of 26 soviet tiles (26/26, same as wave 2). Worse, the surviving strings are not new: read against the wave-2 strings quoted in regen2_verification.json, 19 of 26 are character-for-character identical (afro-house RATH HOUCE, alternative-rnb IIC/IC/LET/NO, chicago-blues HIRTR/TETR/URRS...ON, detroit-techno GNDNG/020T80, drift-phonk REB 8008/EERE EROTOS, euro-trance EUTNISE, free-jazz RII, goa-trance ROBLI...E PR + RO CCIL TE, happy-hardcore RONDEORA/SIPARNER, hard-trance CADINRE, hardstyle RDCYIION/BORCOK, k-pop RAIC, kawaii R01.018, microhouse ROURS, synthwave YEB AER, vaporwave RENCENCT, west-coast PRINT/LO 14S, death-metal's 19-plate grid) and the other 7 differ by at most one or two characters or by plate layout (ambient-techno ED/RO/OCE/CREE, big-beat BIENARCO/RMRIDEGRTRDSS/PEBALOT, black-metal NIRRITE, chicago-drill OMEDEDRNAIR, dream-trance RICE/E/RLAFIS, southern-hip-hop COEL D30/RE-EO, j-pop/thrash-metal grids). For three tiles the _rejected original proves how little changed: hard-trance went THASRE (wave 1) to CADINRE (wave 2 wording attempt) and wave 3 reproduced CADINRE exactly; microhouse went COINS to ROURS and wave 3 kept ROURS; synthwave's YEB AER is untouched. Deleting the vocabulary therefore had no effect - the lettered-surface prior is carried by the skin medium the prompt still requests ('stamped-steel plates with square corners', '2 px milled edges', 'rivets, seams', 'technical-plate frontal composition') and by the subject nouns (drum machine, amplifier wall, sequencer step keys), not by the words that were deleted. (2) Palette: the hard two-ink regional constraint on the 17 sovietYears tiles also failed. Measured off-ink fraction (pixels more than 90 RGB units from black #111111 / red #cc0000 / paper paper #f4f1e1) has median 9.6% for the 12 R2-flagged tiles versus an 8.0% median for the 142 non-flagged sovietYears tiles - i.e. no tightening at all, and the ~8% floor is aged-paper grain plus JPEG noise. All 12 of 12 R2 tiles still show their named colour source, and the residual off-ink pixels cluster on exactly that hue: dream-trance purple #602060 8.6%, afro-house orange #e0c080 9.0% + #e0c060 5.4%, melodic-house green #a0a060/#406020, vaporwave pink #e0a0a0 6.2%, wave fog greys 24.5% off-ink, electro cyan #204040, dancehall/southern-hip-hop/j-pop/kawaii/phonk pastel and multicolour panels. A per-region ink instruction in the text does not stop a semantic object (cloud, aurora, neon, fog, painted speaker) from bringing its own colour. (3) Object re-description: 0 of the 10 object-misread tiles lost the misread object. The harp survives in 4 of 4 chicago-blues tiles (comic, soviet, sovietYears, pixel); the marble bust survives in 3 of 3 vaporwave tiles (comic, soviet, sovietYears); the mirrorball plus live acoustic kit survives in sovietYears/chicago-house; the whisky glass survives in 2 of 2 amapiano tiles (and the snare in sovietYears/amapiano). In several cases the positive phrase was satisfied additively - a small rectangular harmonica was painted while the concert harp stayed - which is exactly the failure mode wave 2 already showed. The only measured wins are incidental sub-features that clear no flagged defect: soviet/death-metal lost the wave-1 red glow and red-lit plates, soviet/synthwave stayed free of the orange/red gradient from wave 2, and pixel/amapiano's drum is now a genuine hide-headed log drum with a mallet. Net: 0/48 to 0/48, 26/26 lettered, 12/12 off-ink hue sources intact, 0/10 misread objects corrected. The evidence is that these residual failures are an intrinsic prior of the requested medium/surface vocabulary, so further prompt editing - wording or structural - inside the current skin specs should be treated as non-viable (three attempts, 0/48 each); the credible remaining options are post-process/inpaint of the text and off-palette regions, or changing the skin's base medium (no stamped-steel plate surfaces and no machine-face surfaces at all, and no sky/floor colour carriers) rather than the trigger vocabulary.
